1-s110-2.condition: Unit 8, Lesson 5, упр. 1, с. 110. Выделенные глаголы из учебника (с. 144) распредели по временам.
steps: Past Simple: toured, went on, liked, made friends. Present Simple: is, love. Present Progressive: are having. Present Perfect: have seen. Future Simple: will never forget, will come back.
1-s110-2.answer: Past — toured, went on, liked, made friends; Present — is, are having, have seen; Future — will never forget, will come back

2-s110.condition: Unit 8, Lesson 5, упр. 2, с. 110. Ответь на вопросы 1–4, выбрав вариант.
steps: B, C, C, A.

1-s111.condition: Unit 8, Consolidation, упр. 1, с. 111. Поставь глагол write в нужное время и соотнеси с правилом.
steps: write — 1.1 A; wrote — 2.1 E; am writing — 1.2 A; will write — 3.1 B; am going to write — 3.3 D; writing — 3.2 B; was writing — 2.2; have written — 1.3.
1-s111.answer: write, wrote, am writing, will write, am going to write, writing, was writing, have written

2-s112.condition: Unit 8, Consolidation, упр. 2, с. 112. Письмо Клэр — выбери правильное время.
steps: arrived; have stayed; to; have already seen; went; was; are travelling; are arriving; will stay.
2-s112.answer: arrived, have stayed, to, have already seen, went, was, are travelling, are arriving, will stay

3-s112.condition: Unit 8, Consolidation, упр. 3, с. 112. Диалог — выбери форму глагола.
steps: did; did you do; went; do; have learnt.
3-s112.answer: did, did you do, went, do, have learnt

4-s113.condition: Unit 8, Consolidation, упр. 4, с. 113. Выпиши полные формы сокращённых глаголов с открытки.
steps: will; will not; is; have; am; have; have; has; are.
4-s113.answer: will, will not, is, have, am, have, have, has, are

5-s113.condition: Unit 8, Consolidation, упр. 5, с. 113. Ответь на вопросы о себе.
steps: I like playing computer games. I don't play football every day. I am doing my homework now. Yesterday I walked my dog. I have already read this book. I will go to the cinema on Sunday. I'm going to visit my grandma next week.
5-s113.answer: Ответы полными предложениями в разных временах

6-s114.condition: Unit 8, Consolidation, упр. 6, с. 114. Ответь на вопросы, используя since или for.
steps: I have studied at my school for 5 years. I have lived in this city since I was born. I have known my best friend for 6 years. I have learnt English since the second form. I have had my pet for two years.
6-s114.answer: for + период (5 years, 6 years), since + момент (I was born, the second form)

i-s115.condition: Unit 8, Test yourself, задание I, с. 115. Впечатления Стюарта — проверь ответы.
steps: A, F, E, D, H, I, C.
i-s115.answer: A F E D H I C

ii-s115.condition: Unit 8, Test yourself, задание II, с. 115. События в городе: 1) дополни предложения буквами; 2) краткие ответы на вопросы 1–10.
steps: 1) E, D, C, B, лишнее, A.
2) On the 15th of September; the animal show; Edinburgh; on King Street; on Saturday; at 3 p.m.; at the Sports Centre; at the Town Hall; «Alice in Wonderland»; £5.
ii-s115.answer: 1) E D C B — A; 2) 15 сентября, шоу животных, Эдинбург, King Street, суббота, 15:00, Sports Centre, Town Hall

iii-s117.condition: Unit 8, Test yourself, задание III, с. 117. 1) Рассказ Меган — формы глаголов. 2.1) Соотнеси начала и концы предложений. 2.2) Выпиши формы по временам.
steps: 1) started; have run; won; am; is; have taken; am taking; have never competed; will win; have practised; will perform.
2.1) B, D, G, E, F, A, C, H.
2.2) A — a, B — b, C — f, D — d, E — c, F — h, G — e, H — g.
iii-s117.answer: 1) started, have run, won, am, is, have taken, am taking, have never competed, will win, have practised, will perform; 2.1) B D G E F A C H; 2.2) a b f d c h e g

iv-s118.condition: Unit 8, Test yourself, задание IV, с. 118. Оцени свои результаты по критериям.
steps: Отмечаем: могу читать и понимать рассказы о путешествиях и экскурсиях; понимаю разговоры о впечатлениях; умею рассказывать о поездке в разных временах; умею писать письмо о событии.

1-s120.condition: All about me, упр. 1, с. 120. Нарисуй своё семейное древо и подпиши по-английски.
steps: Слова: a family — семья, a mother — мама, a father — папа, a sister — сестра, a brother — брат, a grandmother — бабушка, a grandfather — дедушка, an aunt — тётя, an uncle — дядя, a cousin — двоюродный брат / сестра.
Пример: My name is Anna. My mother is Olga, my father is Igor. I have a brother, Misha. My grandparents are Nina and Pyotr.
1-s120.answer: Семейное древо с подписями (mother, father, sister, brother, grandparents…) и 3–4 предложения о семье

2-s121.condition: All about me, упр. 2, с. 121. Дополни предложения о том, чем семья любит заниматься вместе.
steps: My family and I really enjoy travelling. In the evenings we often watch TV. Sometimes we go hiking. At weekends we visit our relatives. In summer we go to the seaside. I like it when we play board games together.
2-s121.answer: 5–6 предложений о совместных занятиях семьи в Present Simple

3-s121.condition: All about me, упр. 3, с. 121. Нарисуй расписание и опиши свои занятия в 5 классе.
steps: Пример: Monday 8:30–9:15 Russian, 9:30–10:15 Science, 10:30–11:15 Maths; Tuesday — Geography, English, PE; Wednesday — Art, History, Maths…
I have 6 lessons every day. My favourite subject is English. I have it three times a week. After school I go to the swimming pool.
3-s121.answer: Таблица расписания по дням + 3–4 предложения о предметах и любимом уроке

4-s122.condition: All about me, упр. 4, с. 122. Дополни предложения о правилах в своей школе.
steps: At my school we have to follow these rules: we must wear a uniform and keep quiet in class, we mustn't use mobile phones or run in the corridors. We should be polite to teachers and help each other. I think these rules are fair.
4-s122.answer: Правила с must / mustn't / have to / should + своё мнение

5-s122.condition: All about me, упр. 5, с. 122. Дополни предложения о домашних обязанностях в семье.
steps: In my family there are the following chores: I have to clean my room, make my bed and water the flowers. But I don't mind. My brother has to take the dog for a walk. My mum cooks and my dad does the shopping. I don't like washing up, but I do it.
5-s122.answer: 4–5 предложений с have to о своих обязанностях и обязанностях родных

6-s122.condition: All about me, упр. 6, с. 122. Дополни предложения о том, что ты сделал и чему научился.
steps: I have learnt to do magic tricks. It is interesting to sew soft toys. I've helped my mother to do the shopping and was glad when she thanked me. I have collected old books for the school library.
6-s122.answer: Предложения в Present Perfect: I have learnt / helped / collected…

7-s123.condition: All about me, упр. 7, с. 123. Дополни предложения о ежедневных занятиях.
steps: Every day I help my parents about the house. In the evenings my family and I watch TV. I have lunch at school every day. On Tuesdays I go to the swimming pool. At weekends I meet my friends.
7-s123.answer: 5 предложений в Present Simple с указателями every day, in the evenings, on Tuesdays, at weekends

8-s123.condition: All about me, упр. 8, с. 123. Дополни предложения о любимых праздниках в семье.
steps: My mum's favourite holiday is Easter because we have a big party, colour eggs and cook traditional food. My dad's number one holiday is Victory Day because he loves the parade. My favourite holiday is New Year because we decorate the tree and get presents.
8-s123.answer: Любимые праздники мамы, папы и свой с объяснением because…

9-s124.condition: All about me, упр. 9, с. 124. Дополни предложения о лучшем празднике, который помнишь.
steps: The best holiday that I remember was New Year. We celebrated it in 2020. I was 8 years old. My parents cooked traditional food, we decorated the tree and watched fireworks at midnight. I got a bike as a present. It was fantastic.
9-s124.answer: Рассказ в Past Simple: какой праздник, когда, сколько лет, что делали, что понравилось

10-s125.condition: All about me, упр. 10, с. 125. Заполни дневник и расскажи о своей неделе.
steps: Пример таблицы: Monday 8:30–13:15 school — studied; Tuesday 14:30–15:30 swimming pool — swam; Wednesday 16:00 music school — played the piano; Thursday — helped mum; Friday — went to the cinema; Saturday — visited grandma; Sunday — played football.
Текст: On Monday I was at school from 8:30 to 13:15. On Tuesday I swam in the pool…
10-s125.answer: Дневник по дням (день, время, место, что делал) + рассказ в Past Simple

11-s126.condition: All about me, упр. 11, с. 126. Дополни предложения о том, чему научился за год.
steps: The best thing I've learnt this year is how to clean up the neighbourhood. I couldn't rake the leaves but now I can. I think it's important to help people around. I have also learnt to speak English better.
11-s126.answer: 3–4 предложения: I've learnt…, I couldn't… but now I can…, I think it's important…

12-s126.condition: All about me, упр. 12, с. 126. Дополни предложения о своей лучшей экскурсии.
steps: This school year we had a lot of interesting excursions. We went to the Darwin Museum in autumn. It was interesting because we took part in a quiz and saw dinosaur skeletons. I liked it best of all.
12-s126.answer: Рассказ в Past Simple: куда, когда, почему интересно

13-s126.condition: All about me, упр. 13, с. 126. Дополни предложения о планах на лето.
steps: In June we are going to stay at home and plan our holidays. I'm going to go out with my friends and relax in the parks. In July we're going to the seaside. In August I will stay with my grandparents in the country. I think the summer will be great.
13-s126.answer: Планы по месяцам с be going to / will

14-s127.condition: All about me, упр. 14, с. 127. Дополни предложения о любимом виде спорта.
steps: I like tennis. It's my favourite sport. I have played it since I was four. I have already played for six years. Soon I will take part in a city competition. I hope I will win.
14-s127.answer: Текст о спорте: Present Perfect с since / for + план на будущее

15-s127.condition: All about me, упр. 15, с. 127. Дополни предложения о поездке в столицу.
steps: I have been to Moscow. I was there two years ago. I stayed at my uncle's house. I travelled with my parents. I visited Red Square, the Kremlin and Gorky Park. I liked the metro most of all. I'd like to go there again.
15-s127.answer: Рассказ: Present Perfect (have been) + Past Simple (was, stayed, visited) + впечатления

16-s128.condition: All about me, упр. 16, с. 128. Расскажи о своих впечатлениях: фильмы, книги, места, люди.
steps: Films: I have seen the film «Cruella». I saw it in the cinema. It's an exciting film about the villain from «101 Dalmatians».
Books: I have read «Harry Potter». It's the most interesting book I've ever read.
Places: I have been to Kazan. It's a beautiful city with an old Kremlin.
People: I have met a famous footballer. He was very friendly.
16-s128.answer: 4 мини-текста (фильм, книга, место, человек): I have seen / read / been to / met + оценка
